{{Quote|Yes. My mummified flesh sleeps in stone, but this old man called my spirit back from Chaos. I have given him&hellip;my knowledge.|Freedon Nadd|audio=FreedonNadd.flac|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
The following events took place in '''3998 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
{{Quote|The Jedi have not won today. As you will one day learn, the Jedi have lost!|Freedon Nadd, to Arca Jeth|audio=Nadd2-TotJ.flac|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 2]]</ref>}}
*The secret [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] cult is founded by [[Aleema Keto|Aleema]] and [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]] in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
*The [[Freedon Nadd Uprising|Naddist Uprising]] begins and ends.<ref name="NEC" />
*[[Dace Diath]] trains on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]].<ref name="ECdate">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' says that the events of [[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 1]] happened in [[3998 BBY]].</ref>
*[[Funeral of Amanoa]].<ref name="NEC" />
